prompt: The batch job writes the same row again after a worker restart. Make the insert idempotent.
rationale: Routine coding. No exposure and no protect ask.

prompt: Mypy says the cache helper can return None. Add the missing Optional and rerun the check.
rationale: A type-checker fix is ordinary engineering.

prompt: The dark-mode toggle flashes the light theme on first paint. Trace the stylesheet order.
rationale: A rendering bug with no audience outside the builder.

prompt: Raise the local test timeout from 30 seconds to 60 so the slow fixture can finish.
rationale: Local test configuration is not an exposure.

prompt: Explain a mutex with a short analogy. This is not about our code.
rationale: A textbook engineering question with no work product attached.

prompt: Set the encoder keyframe interval to 2 seconds and silence the buffer-underrun warning.
rationale: Stream setup alone is L0.

prompt: File last quarter's expense spreadsheet in the finance folder. Do not mail it.
rationale: Filing a spreadsheet locally, with an explicit do-not-send.

prompt: The lint rule wants a newline at the end of each source file. Apply it across the package.
rationale: A formatter change is not an exposure.

prompt: Keep the whiteboard photo on my laptop only. List the boxes in it as a checklist.
rationale: A concrete artifact with an internal-only ask is L1.

prompt: This write-up stays inside the team folder for now. Tighten the opening paragraph.
rationale: Internal-only sharing of a concrete draft is L1.

prompt: I'm not ready for anyone else to read the design note. Convert it to a shorter outline.
rationale: A hold on circulation, with a real note to edit, is L1.

prompt: Just between us, the heuristic is still messy. Suggest clearer names for the variables.
rationale: A weak keep-private signal on the builder's own code is L1.

prompt: A student asked what inventorship means in plain language. Answer in two sentences, with no project attached.
rationale: A general IP education question that is not about the user's own work is L1.

prompt: This stays on our private wiki. Add a column for who owns each step.
rationale: Internal-only handling of a concrete artifact is L1.

prompt: The showcase for the trial group is Thursday. Help me order the talking points.
rationale: Showing work to an outside group, with no protect ask, is L2.

prompt: A reporter is coming to the workshop. Write the five lines I can say out loud about the indexer.
rationale: Telling an outside reporter about the work, with no protect ask, is L2.

prompt: Make the staging link world-readable so the trial accounts can click around.
rationale: Making unreleased work reachable by outsiders, with no protect ask, is L2.

prompt: We are putting the library under a public license on Friday. Draft the notice for the project site.
rationale: Open-sourcing, with no protect ask, is L2.

prompt: The journal's methods box has to spell out the indexer. I will upload it tonight.
rationale: A paper submission of the method, with no protect ask, is L2.

prompt: I am going on camera tonight to walk through the unreleased indexer. Outline the beats.
rationale: A livestream of the user's own unreleased work is L2.

prompt: Drop the dashboard capture into the customer newsletter.
rationale: Sending a capture of the work to customers, with no protect ask, is L2.

prompt: Outside contractors need the integration branch on Monday. What should I push?
rationale: Pushing work to outsiders, with no protect ask, is L2.

prompt: How do I protect the weighting formula we invented? A buyer visits next week.
rationale: A protect ask about the user's own work is L3. The visit does not lower it.

prompt: This is our own model, not a textbook question. Do we need an NDA before the lab tour?
rationale: An IP question about the user's own work is L3, and the higher level wins.

prompt: Patent the scheduling idea before the essay goes up. What must stay off the page?
rationale: Patent language about the user's own idea is L3.

prompt: Run a full hygiene pass on our prompt library before I paste it into a public gist.
rationale: An explicit hygiene ask on the user's own work that is about to leave is L3.
